content.caseIdentity: Anil Rishi v. Gurbaksh Singh, (2006) 5 SCC 558
content.holding: Held that in civil suits alleging forgery or fraud, the initial legal burden under Section 104 rests strictly on the party asserting fraud; the court cannot place the burden on the defendant to prove the negative without foundational evidence.
content.relevance: Authoritative ruling on burden allocation in civil disputes involving registered deeds and alleged undue influence.
